text: My daily routine is simple but well organised. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my day with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I begin work at nine and stay focused until lunchtime. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or going to the gym. In the evening, I relax by cooking dinner, reading, or watching a film with my family. I always go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent with this routine helps me feel energetic, calm, and ready for each new day.
